Seven rooms

All seven rooms are doubles, and between them they sleep fourteen. Only one has air conditioning, so ask when you book if you want the one that has it.

The rooms are furnished much alike. The bed is a mint-green four-poster double with a teal velvet throw on it, and there’s a timber towel ladder and a green cabinet with a mirror.

Deluxe Double Room

1 large double bed | Sleeps 2 | 13 m², with its own bathroom, a private entrance, a terrace and a balcony.

Around the courtyard

Sea You is a white two-storey house. Downstairs there’s an inner courtyard, with potted plants and a cushioned bench, and the room doors that open onto it have carved fanlights over them.

From the balconies upstairs you look out over the garden to the coconut palms. There are tables and chairs out there, and the long one has a settee with green cushions.

Carved doors and a surfboard shower

One of the rooms has a carved grey double door, and the wooden chair beside it is carved too. Elsewhere, carved wooden masks hang by a doorway among the ferns.

Out in the garden there’s a shower built into a wooden surfboard, fixed to the wall under the palms. It’s for rinsing off after the sea.

Breakfast

Breakfast here is Asian, with local specialities and warm dishes, and there’s juice and fruit too.

Finding the house

Booking.com lists the house under Kumbalgama and Airbnb under Matara, but it’s one house, in Midigama.

Midigama railway station is 950 m away on foot and Weligama Beach is 3.4 km, both by Booking.com’s count.

151 Weliwaththa Rd, Midigama 80650, Sri Lanka
